private_physical_transport_opener_behavi: Refuses with reviewed physical capture/transport backend is not installed.
required_backend_features: Open only the exact signed one-card bridge/session after the sealed master gate and durable PRE_TRANSPORT journal.
Set effective MPSSE TCK to 5 MHz before the first TCK edge and prove the effective setting; XVC settck echo does not set it.
Acquire calibrated native analog TCK/SK samples at the exact adapter pin and ground with instrument/probe/calibration/bandwidth/sample-rate/threshold metadata.
Derive period/high/low/duty/jitter from raw time-stamped samples and bind the resulting CSV to the native acquisition hash.
Capture bounded semantic TAP transcript and the additional matrix-approved BSCAN observation with shared nonce/timebase.
Sign role-bound raw evidence using a key rooted in the operator-approved trust store; write and fsync the hash-chain journal.
Enforce one 87-cycle capture, immediate stop on mismatch, no retries/reconnects, and normal close to Run-Test/Idle.
